node.statement: J is unital, and for every r>=1 a positive element (A_1,...,A_n) of M_r(C^n)=direct-sum_{i=1}^n M_r is sent by id_{M_r} tensor J, up to the canonical permutation of tensor factors, to the positive block-diagonal matrix diag(A_1,...,A_n) in M_{rn}; hence J is CP and therefore UCP by def-ucp-map.
